evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we present an evaluation framework spanning five methods that differ in how informative the inserted content is and apply them at the sentence level across seven models spanning multiple sizes on three datasets.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We find that accuracy gains are not always genuine improvements but undirected perturbations: the methods correct some predictions while breaking others, particularly when the inserted text allows only for more computational time.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: However, these methods have been evaluated in isolation and only by their performance gains, leaving it unclear how they compare and whether they reliably improve performance.
